places.name: Llandudno Pier
places.ai_summary: A classic Victorian pier stretching into the Irish Sea, featuring arcades, cafes, and stunning views of the coastline and Great Orme.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary seasonally.

places.place_tip: Visit during sunset for breathtaking views and a relaxing stroll.
places.address: North Parade, Llandudno LL30 2LP, United Kingdom

places.name: Great Orme Tramway
places.ai_summary: A historic cable-hauled tramway that takes visitors to the summit of the Great Orme. The journey offers spectacular views and a unique experience.

opening_hours.notes: Seasonal operation; check website for details.

places.place_tip: Combine the tram ride with a visit to the Great Orme Summit for panoramic views.
places.address: Church Walks, Llandudno LL30 2NB, United Kingdom

places.name: Great Orme Summit & Copper Mines
places.ai_summary: Explore the summit of the Great Orme, offering breathtaking views, and visit the ancient copper mines, one of the oldest in the world.

opening_hours.notes: Copper mines have separate entry fees.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes for exploring the mines and summit trails.
places.address: Great Orme, Llandudno LL30 2XF, United Kingdom

places.name: Promenade & Victorian Seafront
places.ai_summary: A beautiful promenade with a Victorian-era design, offering stunning views of the bay and the Great Orme. Ideal for a leisurely stroll.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the floral clock and the statue of Alice in Wonderland.
places.address: The Promenade, Llandudno LL30 2LP, United Kingdom

places.name: Happy Valley Gardens
places.ai_summary: A picturesque garden located in the heart of Llandudno, featuring a variety of plants, flowers, and walking paths. A peaceful retreat.

opening_hours.notes: Open year-round, but may close early in winter.

places.place_tip: Check out the miniature golf course and the cafe within the gardens.
places.address: Happy Valley, Llandudno LL30 2LP, United Kingdom

attribution.title: Great Orme cable car, Llandudno - geograph.org.uk - 1406487
attribution.author: Paul Harrop
attribution.description: Great Orme cable car, Llandudno Seen from close to the summit terminus. The cable car system has operated for 40 years and is, at about a mile in length, the longest of its kind in the UK. Shortly after this picture was taken, the service was briefly suspended because of high winds.

places.name: West Shore Beach
places.ai_summary: A sandy beach located on the western side of Llandudno, ideal for sunbathing, swimming, and beach sports. Offers a quieter alternative to the North Shore.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during low tide for maximum beach area.

places.place_tip: Look out for the historic Llandudno Jetty at the northern end of the beach.
places.address: West Parade, Llandudno LL30 2BD, United Kingdom

places.name: Venue Cymru
places.ai_summary: Theatrical venue in Llandudno, hosting a variety of performances including concerts, plays, and comedy shows. A cultural hub for locals and visitors.

opening_hours.notes: Check schedule for event timings.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance for popular shows and events.
places.address: The Promenade, Llandudno LL30 1BB, United Kingdom

places.name: Haulfre Gardens
places.ai_summary: Beautifully landscaped gardens located on the slopes of the Great Orme, featuring a variety of plants, trees, and walking paths. Offers great views over Llandudno.

opening_hours.notes: Open year-round, but may close early in winter.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a trip to the Great Orme for a full day of exploration.
places.address: Haulfre Hill, Llandudno LL30 2LP, United Kingdom

places.name: Llandudno Museum
places.ai_summary: A local museum showcasing the history and heritage of Llandudno and the surrounding area. Features exhibits on the Victorian era, local geology, and more.

opening_hours.notes: Check for seasonal variations in opening hours.

places.place_tip: Donations are appreciated to help maintain the museum.
places.address: Gloddaeth Street, Llandudno LL30 2DD, United Kingdom

places.name: Home Front Museum
places.ai_summary: A unique museum dedicated to preserving the history of Llandudno during the Second World War. Features exhibits, memorabilia, and restored rooms.

opening_hours.notes: Limited parking available; consider public transport.

places.place_tip: Look out for the Anderson Shelter in the garden.
places.address: 14-15, Trinity Square, Llandudno LL30 2RA, United Kingdom

places.name: Bodafon Farm Park
places.ai_summary: A family-friendly farm park located on the outskirts of Llandudno, featuring a variety of animals, play areas, and picnic spots. Great for a family day out.

opening_hours.notes: Check website for seasonal variations in opening hours.

places.place_tip: Bring some change for animal feed and enjoy a picnic in the designated areas.
places.address: Bodafon Road, Llandudno LL30 3BB, United Kingdom

places.name: Alice in Wonderland Trail
places.ai_summary: A whimsical trail based on the 'Alice in Wonderland' stories, featuring sculptures and installations along the route. A fun and imaginative walk for all ages.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Start at the Mad Hatter's Statue and follow the signs along the trail.
places.address: Llandudno LL30 2DD, United Kingdom

attribution.description: "Feeding the Rabbits" also known as "Alice in Wonderland"

places.name: Mostyn Contemporary Art Gallery
places.ai_summary: A modern art gallery in Llandudno, showcasing contemporary art exhibitions, events, and educational programs. Housed in a former church building.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Visit the gallery shop for unique art-inspired gifts and souvenirs.
places.address: 12 Vaughan Street, Llandudno LL30 1AB, United Kingdom

places.name: Marine Drive Scenic Road
places.ai_summary: A scenic drive or walk around the Great Orme, offering stunning views of the coastline, Llandudno, and the surrounding mountains. A must-do for visitors.

opening_hours.notes: Drive carefully and be aware of pedestrians.

places.place_tip: Stop at the various viewpoints for photos and enjoy the fresh sea air.
places.address: Marine Drive, Llandudno LL30 2LP, United Kingdom

places.name: Little Orme Walk
places.ai_summary: A scenic walking trail around the Little Orme headland, offering stunning views of the coastline, sea, and surrounding countryside. A great spot for birdwatching.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for birdwatching and enjoy the wildflowers in spring.
places.address: Little Orme, Llandudno LL30 2LP, United Kingdom

places.name: St Tudno’s Church
places.ai_summary: A historic church located on the Great Orme, known for its beautiful architecture, stained glass windows, and peaceful churchyard. A place of worship and reflection.

opening_hours.notes: May be closed during services or special events.

places.place_tip: Respect the peaceful atmosphere and take time to explore the churchyard.
places.address: Great Orme, Llandudno LL30 2XF, United Kingdom

places.name: North Shore Beach
places.ai_summary: A popular sandy beach located on the northern side of Llandudno, ideal for families, swimming, and beach sports. Close to local amenities and attractions.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during low tide for maximum beach area.

places.place_tip: Check out the nearby cafes and shops along the promenade.
places.address: North Parade, Llandudno LL30 2LP, United Kingdom

places.name: Deganwy Castle Ruins
places.ai_summary: The ruins of a historic castle located on a hilltop overlooking Llandudno and the Conwy Estuary. Offers panoramic views and a glimpse into the area's medieval past.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Wear sturdy shoes for the walk up to the ruins and enjoy the views from the top.
places.address: Deganwy, Llandudno LL31 9DJ, United Kingdom

places.name: Church Walks
places.ai_summary: A scenic walking route in Llandudno, offering beautiful views of the town, coastline, and the Great Orme. A popular route for both locals and visitors.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Take your time to enjoy the views and the natural beauty of the area.
places.address: Church Walks, Llandudno LL30 2NB, United Kingdom

places.name: Angel Bay Seal Spotting
places.ai_summary: A scenic viewpoint and coastal area known for seal spotting, especially during the breeding season. A great place for nature enthusiasts and photographers.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for seal spotting and enjoy the coastal walk.
places.address: Angel Bay, Llandudno LL30 2LP, United Kingdom
